summary: Frontend E2E validation of /business-card visual/share fixes for owner test@dalpastro.it. All 7 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) share button says 'Condividi' with no 'retro' suffix, (2) both DOM mirrors bc-front-web + bc-back-web present with class 'bc-face-web', (3) <style id='bc-anim-css'> injected in <head> with keyframes bcShimmerMove + bcGoldPulse + .bc-face-web + .bc-shimmer, (4) FRONTE renders as navy card with diagonal stripes + gold inner border + shimmer, (5) RETRO renders with white->light-grey gradient + 2px navy border + gold glow perimeter + shimmer overlay, (6) clicking Condividi with filled form triggered a real single-PNG download 'biglietto-Emanuele-Test.png' — Playwright captured the native download event AND the anchor.download attempt, confirming html2canvas ran on both mirrors and merged them side-by-side, (7) non-regression: Fronte/Retro side toggles still flip preview, bc-save saved successfully, bc-share-link present. No console errors during share flow.

react_native_issues.issue: React-native-web logs 'Invalid style property of "animation". Did you mean "animationKeyframes"?' twice on business-card mount. The visible card's gold-pulse animation is applied through a raw `animation: bcGoldPulse …` shorthand inside a StyleSheet, which react-native-web does not accept. The animation still runs visually because the injected .bc-face-web class (used on the hidden mirrors) is not affected, but the visible preview card technically does not receive the CSS animation on web. Not blocking (visual glow via boxShadow is present), but should be migrated to `animationName/animationDuration/animationIterationCount/animationTimingFunction` for RN-Web compliance, or moved to the .bc-face-web class by adding it also to the visible flipContainer via a web-only style bridge. Reference: /app/frontend/app/business-card.tsx:694-697

action_items: (Optional/low-priority) Replace the `animation: 'bcGoldPulse 2.6s ease-in-out infinite'` shorthand inside styles.flipContainer (business-card.tsx:696) with the long-form RN-Web properties (animationName, animationDuration, animationIterationCount, animationTimingFunction) OR apply the bc-face-web className on the visible flip container on web to silence the two red console warnings and ensure the visible card also pulses on web.
critical_code_review_comments: business-card.tsx is 783 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting the two web-only mirror <div>s and the injected CSS into a dedicated helper module for maintainability.
The `animation` shorthand in RN StyleSheet.create is a known RN-Web incompatibility — split into long-form properties.
seed_data_creation: Populated form fields on the fly (Name, Title, Phone, Company) with the owner account; no persistent seed data created.
